state.notice_text:
LEGAL NOTICE
Date: 10 November 2026
To: Mr. Ravi Kumar, Flat 12, Shanti Apartments, Indore
Under instructions from my client M/s Sharma Electronics, I hereby call upon you to pay a sum of Rs. 42,500/- (Rupees Forty Two Thousand Five Hundred only) being the balance amount due towards the purchase of a refrigerator and air conditioner on credit in March 2026, within 15 days of receipt of this notice, failing which my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you for recovery along with interest and costs, entirely at your risk.
Sd/- A. Verma, Advocate

ICA1872:s69.heading: Reimbursement of person paying money due by another, in payment of
ICA1872:s69.text:
69. Reimbursement of person paying money due by another, in payment of 
which he is interested 
 
A person who is interested in the payment of money which another is bound by law 
to pay, and who therefore pays it, is entitled to be reimbursed by the other.
ICA1872:s69.full_text:

which he is interested 
 
A person who is interested in the payment of money which another is bound by law 
to pay, and who therefore pays it, is entitled to be reimbursed by the other.

explanation.plain_summary: You have received a notice from Advocate A. Verma asking you to pay Rs. 42,500 within 15 days for a refrigerator and air‑conditioner bought on credit. The notice warns that if you do not pay, the sender may start legal proceedings to recover the amount with interest and costs.

claims.text: The notice treats the amount as a sum payable on demand under a credit agreement, which is a type of contract for money lent.
claims.quote: For money lent under an agreement that it shall be payable on demand. Three years. When the loan is made.

claims.text: Do not panic. Note the date you actually received the notice (not the date printed on it). Gather any documents related to the purchase – receipts, credit agreement, payment records, and any correspondence. If you dispute the amount or the claim, consider contacting free legal aid services in Indore for advice.

If you are able to pay the amount, you may do so within the 15‑day period to avoid further costs. If you cannot pay or believe the demand is incorrect, you can reply in writing stating your position and request a detailed statement of the debt.

cannot_assess: Whether a valid credit agreement exists between you and the seller, as the notice does not include a copy of the contract.
Whether any part of the amount has already been paid or set off against other obligations.
lawyer_needed_when: You dispute the existence or amount of the debt.
The sender initiates legal proceedings and you need to defend the claim.

verdicts.reason: The source text explicitly states the limitation period applies to money lent under an agreement that it shall be payable on demand, which supports the statement's description of the legal basis.

kind.is: A letter from the other side (often through their lawyer) stating what they want.
is_not: It is not a court order or a judgment. A court has not decided anything because of this letter.
It does not by itself mean a case has been filed.
What it says about the law is their version; it may be right, exaggerated or wrong.

options.name: Ignore it
options.risk: Silence can be read as not disputing their claims, and you lose track of any deadline they set. Not recommended without advice.

options.name: Send a short factual reply
options.risk: Anything you write can be used later. Stick to facts, deny what is wrong, admit nothing you are unsure of.

options.name: Negotiate / ask for documents
options.risk: Asking for the documents they rely on costs little and buys time, but note their deadline.

options.name: Pay what they ask
options.risk: Ends the dispute fast but may mean paying something not owed. Get it in writing as full and final settlement.

options.name: Get free legal help first (DLSA / NALSA 15100)
options.risk: Takes a little time; do it well before their deadline.

result.reply_warning: A reply to a legal notice can create admissions. Keep it short and factual, do not apologise for things you did not do, and have an advocate or the DLSA check it if the amount matters to you.
threats: my client shall be constrained to initiate appropriate legal proceedings against you for recovery along with interest and costs, entirely at your risk.
gather: The notice and its envelope / courier slip (proves when it reached you)
Any agreement, bill, invoice or messages the notice refers to
Proof of any payments you already made
A note of the date you received it and how (post, courier, WhatsApp, email)
